description: Two sample-and-hold sections in 2HP, each with a mode switch, an internal clock and a built-in noise source when nothing is patched in

params.text: Chooses what that section does: S&H samples the input at each trigger, T&H passes the input while the clock is high and holds it while low, H&T does the reverse
Sets the rate of that section's internal clock, from 0.0039Hz fully counter-clockwise to 1024Hz fully clockwise, and is ignored while a clock is patched

inputs.text: The clock that section follows, read as a trigger in S&H and as a gate in the two tracking modes; a polyphonic clock samples each channel on its own
The signal that section samples; with the jack empty the section samples its own white noise instead

outputs.text: Carries the value that section is holding, or the input itself while it is tracking

notes: with nothing patched into a signal input, that section samples white noise between -5V and +5V, which makes it a random voltage source without any other module
the number of output channels comes from the signal input if one is patched, otherwise from the clock input, otherwise from the noise polyphony on the menu
the held values are saved with the patch, so a section comes back holding what it held
menu: A-Noise range, B-Noise range — sets the range of that section's built-in noise, -5V to 5V unless you change it
A-Noise polyphony, B-Noise polyphony: 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many channels of independent noise that section makes when nothing is patched into its signal input
A-LFO high/low ratio, B-LFO high/low ratio: 10%/90% up to 90%/10% — sets how much of each internal clock cycle is high, which matters in the two tracking modes
A-LFO rate chaos, B-LFO rate chaos — picks a new random speed for each cycle of that section's internal clock, and does nothing while a clock is patched
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Auto select process quality — picks the process quality from the dialled-in rate and from which ports are patched, and greys out the manual choice while it is on
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads that section's internal clock; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads that section's internal clock; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads that section's own white noise.
inputs.3:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads that section's own white noise.
